units.source_text: 大约是佛菩萨特地要劝薰中纳言厌离此世，因而叫他经受一番如此惨酷的苦厄吧，

en.t: Perhaps the Buddhas and bodhisattvas meant to make the Middle Counselor Kaoru grow weary of this world, and so had him undergo such a cruel ordeal.

units.source_text: 大女公子眼见得渐渐停止呼吸，像草木枯萎一般消逝了，呜呼哀哉！

en.t: Before their eyes, the elder princess gradually stopped breathing and faded away like withering grass and trees. Alas, how sorrowful!

units.source_text: 薰中纳言无法挽留，便捶胸顿足，号啕大哭起来，也顾不得旁人讥诮了。

en.t: Unable to hold her back, the Middle Counselor Kaoru beat his breast, stamped his feet, and broke into loud sobs, no longer caring if others mocked him.

units.source_text: 二女公子看见姐姐已经死去，放声痛哭，定欲追随同行，这也是难怪她的。

en.t: When the younger princess saw that her elder sister had died, she wailed aloud and surely wished to follow her; no one could blame her for that.

units.source_text: 那几个多嘴多舌的侍女说道：“在亡人身边是不祥的！”

en.t: Those talkative waiting women said, "It is unlucky to remain beside the dead!"

units.source_text: 便把不省人事的二女公子拉开，扶往别处去。

en.t: So they pulled the unconscious younger princess away and supported her as they took her elsewhere.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想：“无论如何不会有这等事，这不是做梦么？”

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru thought, "There is no way such a thing can be real. Is this not a dream?"

units.source_text: 便移近灯火，仔细观看，但见衣袖遮掩的颜面像沉沉入睡一样，端正美丽，与生前无异。

en.t: He moved the lamp closer and looked carefully; the face partly hidden by her sleeves seemed deeply asleep, composed and beautiful, no different from when she was alive.

units.source_text: 他悲痛之余，竟想让这遗骸就此躺着，像蝉壳一般永久保存，常常得见。

en.t: In the depth of his grief, he even wished the remains could lie there as they were, preserved forever like a cicada shell, so that he might always see her.

units.source_text: 举行临终法事之时，照例须梳发。

en.t: When the rites for the dead were performed, her hair had to be combed according to custom.

units.source_text: 梳时芬芳四溢，气息全同生前一样，真乃一种美妙可爱的香气。

en.t: As it was combed, fragrance spread all around; the scent was exactly as it had been in life, truly a wondrous and lovely perfume.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想道：“我总希望能在此人身上某处找出缺点，以便减轻思慕之苦。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru thought, "I keep hoping I might find some flaw in her, somewhere, so that the pain of longing for her may be eased.

units.source_text: 倘佛菩萨真欲劝我厌离人世而行方便，务请助我发见可怕、可厌之处，使我减少悲伤！”

en.t: If the Buddhas and bodhisattvas truly wish to guide me away from this world through such means, please help me discover something frightening or hateful in her, so that my sorrow may lessen!"

units.source_text: 他如此向佛祈愿。

en.t: Thus he prayed to the Buddha.

units.source_text: 然而悲伤越发难以排遣。

en.t: Yet his grief became still harder to dispel.

units.source_text: 他就决心：“不如硬着心肠，送她去火葬吧！”

en.t: At last he resolved, "I must harden my heart and send her to be cremated."

units.source_text: 于是照例准备仪式，真乃痛苦之事！

en.t: So the ceremony was prepared according to custom, and it was truly a painful thing.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言由人扶着前往送葬，神思恍惚，两足如行空中。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru went to the funeral procession supported by others, his mind dazed, his feet seeming to walk through empty air.

units.source_text: 这最后的仪式也很寂寥，升空的烟亦不甚多。

en.t: This final rite too was very lonely, and the smoke rising into the sky was not very great.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言垂头丧气，茫茫然地返归宇治山庄。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru hung his head in despair and returned, dazed and empty, to the villa at Uji.
